scope: Fix the five numeric-conversion warnings identified in session timeout configuration and WebRTC inputs
acceptance_criteria: Reuse the existing integer utility package; add only one checked uint16 conversion used by all three WebRTC casts
Reject timeout values that overflow either the signed conversion or seconds-to-nanoseconds multiplication
Validate timeouts before changing existing timers and report invalid initialization through the existing failure packet before greeting output
Preserve disabled zero timeouts and valid numeric boundaries
Ignore and record malformed ICE indices without enqueueing a wrapped candidate
Reject invalid or incomplete UDP port ranges; preserve the default when both endpoints are zero
risks: Previously accepted malformed settings now fail explicitly
ConfigureTimeouts gains an error return on the internal lifecycle contract; its production caller must handle it
The worktree contains earlier uncommitted interruption changes that must remain intact
verification_commands: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.go' ':!protos/**' | xargs -n 1 dirname | sort -u | sed 's|^|./|' | xargs env CGO_ENABLED=1 golangci-lint run --allow-serial-runners --timeout=5m --enable-only gosec
just agent-finalize with the exact allowed_paths inventory
non_goals: Do not change unrelated scanner findings or disable the security hook
Do not enable native playback callback authority
Do not change protobuf or public API schemas

native_security_scan.note: No global scanner exclusions or hook bypass were added. The checked uint16 converter follows the existing guarded-cast annotation pattern. Remaining warnings match the prior unrelated findings.

independent_review.summary: Independent read-only review found no correctness, regression, architecture, or material coverage issue in the scoped numeric fixes. The reviewer verified production error-return handling and reviewed the named boundary tests; test execution was coordinator-owned.
